title: Teodoro denies Asean members opposed PH handling of China invite

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Defense Secretary Gilberto Teodoro Jr. on Tuesday denied China’s claim that several Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) countries had opposed the Philippines’ handling of Beijing’s participation in last week’s regional defense meetings in Cebu. Teodoro said no Asean member state had raised concerns with him over Manila’s handling of China’s participation
